name: compare-01
title: Compare 01 - Two Things Side By Side, No Verdict
description: Two things compared in the shape the word implies: a real table with a shared row of labels down the left, or a stacked form that puts one arm above the other on a narrow screen. Prism ships no winner, no check on the better column and no highlight, because a design system that marks a winner is making a claim about a market.
